audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Gwen 'he' and 'his' in nine places — tldr, winCon, three phase whys, both trade lines, the snowball line and two trigger cards — and diff says HARD while breakdown.difficulty and the final rating say 'Tricky matchup'.
audit.why: A page that cannot keep the opponent’s pronoun straight reads as generic filler, and the grade contradicting itself makes both numbers untrustworthy. At 47.92% the HARD label is the defensible one.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed to her throughout the full layer, and the difficulty line and final rating changed to Hard so the whole page agrees with diff.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is named the clock on six lines and no cooldown appears anywhere in either layer, so "wait out the mist" has no duration attached.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s with a partial refund if she connects, Snip Snip! 6.5s at rank 1 and Needlework 120s. Against your Miasma at 24s, the 22s mist means her cloud is up slightly more often than your grounding.
audit.corrected: 22s, 13s, 6.5s and 120s written into the cooldown block, the trigger card, the loading tip and whys[3], with the Skip 'n Slash refund noted so you do not count a flat 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says of Hallowed Mist 'never burn damage into it' and 'Fights start when Hallowed Mist ends', which is wrong for two-thirds of your kit. It also writes the ability as Snip Snip in three content slots.
audit.why: Riot's Hallowed Mist text is specific: 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' It blocks targeting, not damage. Noxious Blast blasts an area and Miasma releases clouds — neither targets her, so both keep ticking poison on a Gwen standing in the mist, and the poison is what makes Twin Fang free the instant she steps out. Only Twin Fang is actually denied. The ability name is Snip Snip! with the exclamation mark.
audit.corrected: The mist restated as a targeting block rather than a damage block, with the instruction to keep Q poison on her inside it; Snip Snip! corrected in all three content slots.

notes: Hallowed Mist blocking targeting rather than damage is taken straight from Riot's own wording ('She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist'); whether every Cassiopeia zone tick behaves that way in the live client is not confirmed by any local file, so the page now says Q poison still lands and stops short of claiming Miasma does too. Grievous Wounds is recommended against A Thousand Cuts per the needs-antiheal rule. Twin Fang's derived 'projectile' flag contradicts its targeted description and nothing here relies on it.
